Let me analyze this question about light travel time from the Sun to Earth.

The key facts:
- The average distance from Sun to Earth is approximately 150 million kilometers (1 AU)
- Light travels at approximately 300,000 km/s in vacuum

Calculation: 150,000,000 km ÷ 300,000 km/s ≈ 500 seconds ≈ 8 minutes 20 seconds

- Agent 1 said 12 minutes (this is incorrect - too long)
